objective: couple measured surface handoff to old-support retirement before learned policy
split: same 40 BUILD / 9 HELD as first experiment

rules.action: create measured surface groups from BUILD-only raw anchors
rules.eligibility: actual RGB-valid associations and support in at least two distinct BUILD frames; source identifiers retained
rules.shape: tangent size derived from local spacing and capped; thickness limited to measured-surface band

rules.action: link old support to measured group using actual joint alpha*T and depth-consistent measurements
rules.ambiguous: large kernels touching multiple groups remain mixed until split; no pointwise identity truth inferred

rules.action: fit shared group handoff parameters for old and new representations together
rules.constraint: in the rendered result, old-plus-new measured-group coverage must track pre-handoff coverage, while original measured RGB and depth constrain placement
rules.rendering: all physical rows join one depth sort; no view mask used to paste imagery

rules.action: keep unknown lower support distinct from measured transfer
rules.negative_evidence: first-return segments are witnesses with finite pose uncertainty; no whole-cell empty label from a ray hit

rules.action: freeze all candidate groups and transfer coefficients before HELD evaluation
rules.appearance: only a6 measured BUILD RGB; no colors from a37 or road

arms: coupled handoff with identical retirement request

primary_gate.held_panel: both RGB and measured depth improve relative to the retirement-only control
primary_gate.original_view: no-edit quality is checked in the new scene
primary_gate.other_surfaces: a37, measured road, seam and non-target local changes remain within fixed previous guards
primary_gate.coverage: measured old-plus-new group alpha*T deviation explicitly bounded; scalar opacity sum is not a conservation claim
primary_gate.reveal: same fixed PVD denominator; no hidden-geometry accuracy claim

learning_entry: only after positive-control and actual-scene heuristic gates pass; compare learned action ranking on frozen candidate/action interface
